lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Basin, 2148. Sand to the horizon with racks standing out of it like fenceposts, and a heat shimmer over a machine that never stopped drawing power.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Ash Camp's two ridges that way. I learned to shoot on this ground and I have not come back to it since.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is a man on the north ridge. He has been there long enough that the sand has drifted against him, and he does not appear to have noticed you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ridges are empty. Whoever used to watch this place went south the year the stronghold fell.
